posts.title: Where to stay in Dublin: The Iveagh Garden Hotel
posts.description: In the center of Dublin, The Iveagh Garden Hotel has positioned itself at Europe’s first fully sustainable hotel. posts.title: Northern Ireland: Giant’s Causeway
posts.description: Northern Ireland’s Giant’s Causeway is an almost supernatural setting, consisting of thousands of basaltic columns in surprising formations, all seemingly rising out of the Atlantic Ocean.
